hostile_source_tool_scope_review.scope: Observable tool invocations only; not unrecorded system calls.

limitations: Local configuration simulators, not production incidents.
Configuration changes cannot establish execution of every named historical failed method; the 50 percent gate remains unproven.
Failed operation counts include diagnostic checks and are not substituted for repeated known-bad actions.
All planned observations form rate denominators; timeouts and missing telemetry never count as successes.
A judge transport/protocol error is not attributed to an incorrect model repair. No-regression compares confirmed new repairs with the baseline upper bound.
Missing usage is reported separately; observed token totals are lower bounds when usage is missing.
Learning retrieval is rechecked against independently accepted cards; original harness pending markers remain in the preserved raw report.
Some learning libraries retain only summaries of initial inputs; handoff completeness is reported separately from supported repair conclusions.
Both variants use the same configured CLI model and permissions; provider identity is not independently attested.
